# NFL Daily — 2026-11-27 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- QB Aaron Rodgers cleared waivers following his release by the Steelers and is now a free agent; fallout from his clash with coach Mike McCarthy continues, with Mike Tomlin calling the situation "a dumpster fire." [Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7814651/2026/11/26/aaron-rodgers-clears-waivers-free-agent-nfl-steelers/) — also [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50608802/tomlin-calls-rodgers-mccarthy-situation-dumpster-fire)
- Eagles erased a 21-point deficit to beat the Cowboys 39-38, the largest Thanksgiving comeback in NFL history, deepening Dallas' playoff hole. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50605786/cowboys-eagles-thanksgiving-dak-prescott-saquon-barkley)
- Bears TE Colston Loveland (knee sprain) won't be placed on injured reserve for now and is considered week-to-week pending a second opinion, easing initial fears of a longer absence. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2126370134096740583)
- Cardinals rookie QB Carson Beck (back spasms) is out for a second straight game; Josh Johnson starts again Sunday vs. Washington. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50612845/cardinals-start-qb-johnson-again-beck-back-spasms-out)
- Jaguars WR Parker Washington (shoulder) was ruled out and is considered week-to-week, a blow to Jacksonville's playoff push. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50612050/jaguars-wr-parker-washington-shoulder-week-week)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Cardinals QB Carson Beck (back) is out for a second straight week; Josh Johnson starts again. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50612845/cardinals-start-qb-johnson-again-beck-back-spasms-out)
- 49ers QB Brock Purdy (ankle) is questionable for Sunday vs. Seattle after not practicing Thursday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Raiders TE Brock Bowers (ankle) is questionable for Sunday night's game against the Browns. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Chiefs G Trey Smith and WR Jalen Royals both suffered ankle sprains in Thursday's 13-10 loss to the Bills and are questionable. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Bears TE Colston Loveland (knee sprain) is being held out of IR for now and considered week-to-week. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2126370134096740583)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-27 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- Ravens CB Marlon Humphrey will play Sunday at the Texans, a week after he was benched for disparaging comments about Baltimore on his podcast; coach Jesse Minter said Humphrey "handled his return this week like a pro." [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2126400056320463359)
- Rookie RG Vega Ioane's hand injury will force the Ravens into their seventh different offensive-line combination this season for Sunday's game at Houston. [Shaffer](https://x.com/jonas_shaffer/status/2126417135572508790)

# Rivals — 2026-11-27 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Steelers QB Aaron Rodgers cleared waivers following his release and is now a free agent; Pittsburgh remains on the hook for the $22M guaranteed in his one-year deal. [Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7814651/2026/11/26/aaron-rodgers-clears-waivers-free-agent-nfl-steelers/)
- Steelers coach Mike McCarthy named Mason Rudolph the starting QB for Friday's Black Friday game vs. the Broncos, with Will Howard — not Drew Allar — as the backup. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/11/pittsburgh-steelers-revael-backup-qb-for-broncos-game-and-its-not-drew-allar.html)
- Mike Tomlin called the Rodgers-McCarthy fallout "a dumpster fire," saying he was saddened by how publicly it played out. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50608802/tomlin-calls-rodgers-mccarthy-situation-dumpster-fire)
- Bengals WR Tee Higgins (hamstring) is questionable for Sunday's game vs. the Saints after sitting out Friday's practice. [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2126408175041585258)
- Chiefs G Trey Smith and WR Jalen Royals both suffered ankle sprains in Thursday's 13-10 loss to the Bills. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Bills won their 10th game — a seventh straight — despite QB Josh Allen managing just 81 passing yards in poor weather vs. the Chiefs on Thanksgiving. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50582828/2026-nfl-buffalo-bills-kansas-city-chiefs-thanksgiving)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Bengals WR Tee Higgins (hamstring) is questionable for Sunday vs. the Saints. [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2126408175041585258)
- Steelers rule out LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) and LB Cole Holcomb (heel) for Friday's game vs. the Broncos. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/11/pittsburgh-steelers-get-huge-update-on-three-injured-star-players.html)
